title: 0. Bật SQL Agent
intro: SQL Server Agent phải chạy thì Job (bước 6) mới tự động thực thi. Bản Express không có Agent.
steps: Mở SQL Server Configuration Manager (hoặc services.msc).
Chuột phải SQL Server Agent (tên instance) → Properties → Start Mode = Automatic → Start.
Hoặc chạy lệnh CMD/PowerShell (quyền Administrator) bên dưới.
Chạy lệnh T-SQL để bật Agent XPs và kiểm tra trạng thái.
note: Instance mặc định có service tên SQLSERVERAGENT; instance có tên (vd SQLEXPRESS) là SQLAgent$TENINSTANCE.

blocks.name: CMD / PowerShell (Administrator) - instance mặc định
blocks.sql:
sc config SQLSERVERAGENT start= auto
net start SQLSERVERAGENT

blocks.name: T-SQL - bật Agent XPs
blocks.sql:
USE [master]
GO
EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1
RECONFIGURE
GO
EXEC sp_configure 'Agent XPs', 1
RECONFIGURE
GO

blocks.name: T-SQL - kiểm tra trạng thái Agent
blocks.sql:
SELECT servicename, status_desc, startup_type_desc
FROM sys.dm_server_services
WHERE servicename LIKE N'SQL Server Agent%'

title: 1. Tạo user SQL
intro: Tạo login SQL Server và gán quyền cho database làm việc.
steps: Mở SSMS, kết nối vào instance bằng Windows Authentication.
Bật chế độ SQL Server and Windows Authentication (Server Properties → Security) rồi restart service nếu chưa bật.
Chạy lệnh bên dưới.

blocks.name: Tạo login + user

title: 2. Tạo linked server
intro: Kết nối tới SQL Server nguồn để đọc dữ liệu chuyến.
steps: Đảm bảo máy client ping/telnet được tới server nguồn (cổng 1433).
Chạy lệnh tạo linked server.
Kiểm tra bằng câu lệnh test ở cuối.

blocks.name: Tạo linked server
Test kết nối
blocks.sql:
EXEC sp_testlinkedserver N'{{LINK}}'
SELECT TOP 5 * FROM [{{LINK}}].[{{DB}}].sys.tables

CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[Daily_ODP_Detail_View]
AS
SELECT     TOP (100) PERCENT CONVERT(char(10), dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.ODP_Date, 120) AS 日期, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Workstation AS 站号, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Work_Code AS 工作代码, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Workcode_Desc AS 工作状况, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Employee_Id AS 员工号, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Employee_Name AS 员工姓名, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Style_Id AS 款式ID, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Style_Desc AS 款式名称, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Lot AS 床次, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Colour AS 颜色, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Size AS 尺码, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Primary_Code, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Primary_Desc AS 主工序, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Operation_Code, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Operation_Desc AS 子工序, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Standard AS 标准工时, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Quantity AS 数量, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Actual_Time AS 实际时间, CONVERT(varchar(10), 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Start_Time, 108) AS 开始时间, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Pay_Cat AS 工资方式, 
                      dbo.Style_Operations.Pay_Rate * dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Quantity AS 工资, dbo.Style_Operations.Pay_Rate AS 工价, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Fmis_Op_Code AS 工序代码, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Process_Order AS 序号, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Style_Order_Code AS 订单号, 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Is_Completed AS 是否完成, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Line_Number AS 线号,
					  dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.order_id, Daily_ODP_Detail.zd_id
FROM         dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.Style_Operations ON dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Style_Id = dbo.Style_Operations.Style_Id AND 
                      dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Operation_Code = dbo.Style_Operations.Operation_Code
WHERE     (dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Quantity > 0)
ORDER BY 日期, dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail.Operation_Code, 员工姓名, 款式名称


GO

create PROC [dbo].[pr_DayBangQC]
AS

DECLARE @NgayHT DATE = GETDATE()
DECLARE @NgayGanNhat DATE 

SELECT @NgayGanNhat = MAX(Ngay) FROM tblQCTRE

IF @NgayGanNhat IS NULL SET @NgayGanNhat = DATEADD(DAY,-10,@NgayHT)

DECLARE @NgayHT1 DATE = @NgayHT
DECLARE @NgayGanNhat1 DATE = @NgayGanNhat

DECLARE @DiaChi NVARCHAR(30)
SELECT @DiaChi = DiaChi FROM dbo.tblDiaChi

WHILE DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayGanNhat,@NgayHT) >=0
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM tblQCTRE WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY,Ngay,@NgayGanNhat) = 0

	INSERT INTO dbo.tblQCTRE
	(
		DiaChi,
		Ngay,
		MaHang,
		MaNS,
		Operation_Code,
		TenOP,
		LoiNgay,
		TGSua,
		DaSua,
		ChuaSua
		
	)
	SELECT @DiaChi,@NgayGanNhat,  t.zd_id, Employee_ID,t.Operation_Code,c.Description, COUNT(is_redo) AS TongLoi,
	 SUM(DATEDIFF(s,In_Time,out_time)) AS TongTime,
	SUM(CASE WHEN t.out_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DaSua,
	SUM(CASE WHEN t.out_time IS  NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ChuaSua
	FROM Hanger_Details t
	INNER JOIN Operation_Codes c ON t.Operation_Code = c.Operation_Code
	WHERE is_redo = '1'
	AND datediff(day,Staging_Time,@NgayGanNhat) = 0
	GROUP BY t.zd_id, Employee_ID,t.Operation_Code,c.Description

	SET @NgayGanNhat = DATEADD(DAY,1,@NgayGanNhat)
END 


DELETE FROM TNG.TNG_QLSX.dbo.tblQCTRE WHERE DiaChi = @DiaChi AND Ngay BETWEEN @NgayGanNhat1 AND @NgayHT1

INSERT INTO TNG.TNG_QLSX.dbo.tblQCTRE (DiaChi,Ngay,MaHang,MaNS,Operation_Code,TenOP,LoiNgay,DaSua,ChuaSua,TGSua) 
SELECT DiaChi,Ngay,MaHang,MaNS,Operation_Code,TenOP,LoiNgay,DaSua,ChuaSua,TGSua FROM dbo.tblQCTRE WHERE DiaChi = @DiaChi AND Ngay BETWEEN @NgayGanNhat1 AND @NgayHT1

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[pr_DayMaHang]
AS

DECLARE @DiaChi NVARCHAR( 30) = 'DT15'
select @DiaChi = DiaChi from tblDiaChi

SELECT DISTINCT MaHang,TenKieuDang INTO #BangMaHang
FROM TNG.TNG_TrungGian.dbo.TDGV_SoDoChuyen_ViTri_API
WHERE DiaChi = @DiaChi
AND DATEDIFF(DAY,GETDATE(),NgayBatDauSX) >0


DECLARE @MaHang NVARCHAR(250)
DECLARE @KieuDang NVARCHAR(250)
DECLARE @sTma NVARCHAR(250)
DECLARE Curr2 CURSOR FOR

SELECT DISTINCT MaHang,TenKieuDang FROM #BangMaHang

OPEN Curr2
FETCH NEXT FROM Curr2 INTO @MaHang, @KieuDang
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

	IF  N' ' + @KieuDang + N' ' LIKE N'%[ .,;:]bộ[ .,;:]%'
	BEGIN
		SET @sTma = @Mahang + '-A'
		EXEC pr_DayMaHang_EX @MaHang , @sTma,@Diachi

		SET @sTma = @Mahang + '-Q'
		EXEC pr_DayMaHang_EX @MaHang , @sTma,@Diachi

	END 
	ELSE
    BEGIN
		EXEC pr_DayMaHang_EX @MaHang , @MaHang,@Diachi
	END 

	FETCH NEXT FROM Curr2 INTO @MaHang, @KieuDang
END
CLOSE Curr2
DEALLOCATE Curr2

create   PROC [dbo].[pr_DayTrungGian]
AS


DECLARE @MaBoPhan NVARCHAR(5) 
Declare @DiaChi nvarchar(25) 

--SELECT CONNECTIONPROPERTY('local_net_address')

set @DiaChi = 'DT15'
select @DiaChi = DiaChi from tblDiaChi

DECLARE @Date DATETIME

set @Date = GETDATE()
set @MaBoPhan = '0303'

DECLARE @NgayHT DATETIME 
set @NgayHT = GETDATE()


SELECT DISTINCT  zd_id   as Style_Id INTO #BangMa FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
WHERE datediff(day,@NgayHT,ODP_Date) = 0

DELETE FROM tblBangTrungGianNgay WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayHT,Ngay) = 0

DECLARE @MaHang NVARCHAR(250)
DECLARE @SoLuong1 INT 
DECLARE @SoLuongHT INT 

DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR

	SELECT Style_Id   FROM #BangMa
OPEN	cur1
FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @MaHang
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN	

	SELECT @SoLuongHT = SUM(Quantity),  @SoLuong1 = SUM(redo_quantity)  FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
	WHERE zd_id = @MaHang
	AND Is_Completed = 1
	AND DATEDIFF(DAY,ODP_Date,@NgayHT) = 0

	SELECT  @SoLuong1 = SUM(redo_quantity)  FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
	WHERE zd_id = @MaHang
	AND DATEDIFF(DAY,ODP_Date,@NgayHT) = 0

	IF @SoLuongHT > 0
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM tblBangTrungGianNgay WHERE MaHang = @MaHang AND DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayHT,Ngay) = 0
		INSERT INTO tblBangTrungGianNgay 
		VALUES (@MaHang,@MaBoPhan,ISNULL(@SoLuongHT,0),@NgayHT,@DiaChi,@SoLuong1 )
	END

	DELETE FROM tblDuLieuNSTT WHERE MaHang = @MaHang AND DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayHT,Ngay) = 0 
	INSERT INTO tblDuLieuNSTT
	SELECT @DiaChi, zd_id,Employee_ID,@NgayHT,  Operation_code,Operation_Desc , SUM(Quantity) AS SL,0,0,SUM(redo_quantity) FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
	WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY,ODP_date,@NgayHT) = 0 
	AND Quantity >0
	AND zd_id = @MaHang
	GROUP BY zd_id,Employee_ID,Operation_code,Operation_Desc

	UPDATE tblDuLieuNSTT SET STT = q.STT, ThoiGian = q.ThoiGian

	FROM tblDuLieuNSTT t
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT zd_id AS MaHang, 员工号 AS MaNS,Operation_Code,子工序 AS TenCongDoan,序号 AS STT,SUM(数量) AS SoLuong,SUM(实际时间) AS ThoiGian 
	FROM dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail_View 
	WHERE 日期 = CONVERT(VARCHAR,@NgayHT,23)
	AND zd_id = @MaHang   
	GROUP BY 员工号,子工序,序号,zd_id,Operation_Code
	) q ON t.MaHang = q.MaHang COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AND t.OPTEN = q.TenCongDoan COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AND t.MaNS = q.MaNS
	WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY,t.Ngay,@NgayHT) = 0

	FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @MaHang
END

CLOSE cur1
DEALLOCATE cur1

create    PROC [dbo].[pr_DayTrungGian_Ngay]
@Date DATETIME 
AS


DECLARE @MaBoPhan NVARCHAR(5) 
set @MaBoPhan = '0303'


Declare @DiaChi nvarchar(25) 

set @DiaChi = 'DT15'
select @DiaChi = DiaChi from tblDiaChi

set @MaBoPhan = '0303'

DECLARE @NgayHT DATETIME 
set @NgayHT = @Date


SELECT DISTINCT zd_id AS Style_Id  INTO #BangMa FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
WHERE datediff(day,@NgayHT,ODP_Date) = 0

DELETE FROM tblBangTrungGianNgay WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayHT,Ngay) = 0

DECLARE @MaHang NVARCHAR(250)
DECLARE @SoLuong1 INT 
DECLARE @SoLuongHT INT 

DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR

	SELECT Style_Id   FROM #BangMa
OPEN	cur1
FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @MaHang
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN	

	SELECT @SoLuongHT = SUM(Quantity),  @SoLuong1 = SUM(redo_quantity)  FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
	WHERE zd_id = @MaHang
	AND Is_Completed = 1
	AND DATEDIFF(DAY,ODP_Date,@NgayHT) = 0

	SELECT  @SoLuong1 = SUM(redo_quantity)  FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
	WHERE zd_id = @MaHang
	AND DATEDIFF(DAY,ODP_Date,@NgayHT) = 0

	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM tblBangTrungGianNgay WHERE MaHang = @MaHang AND DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayHT,Ngay) = 0
		INSERT INTO tblBangTrungGianNgay 
		VALUES (@MaHang,@MaBoPhan,ISNULL(@SoLuongHT,0),@NgayHT,@DiaChi,@SoLuong1 )
	end

	DELETE FROM tblDuLieuNSTT WHERE MaHang = @MaHang AND DATEDIFF(DAY,@NgayHT,Ngay) = 0 
	INSERT INTO tblDuLieuNSTT
	SELECT @DiaChi, zd_id,Employee_ID,@NgayHT,  Operation_code,Operation_Desc , SUM(Quantity) as SL,0,0,SUM(redo_quantity) FROM Daily_ODP_Detail
	WHERE datediff(day,ODP_date,@NgayHT) = 0 
	AND zd_id = @MaHang
	AND Quantity >0
	Group by zd_id,Employee_ID,Operation_code,Operation_Desc

	UPDATE tblDuLieuNSTT SET STT = q.STT, ThoiGian = q.ThoiGian

	FROM tblDuLieuNSTT t
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT zd_id AS MaHang, 员工号 AS MaNS,Operation_Code,子工序 AS TenCongDoan,序号 AS STT,SUM(数量) AS SoLuong,SUM(实际时间) AS ThoiGian 
	FROM dbo.Daily_ODP_Detail_View 
	WHERE 日期 = convert(varchar,@NgayHT,23)
	AND zd_id = @MaHang   
	GROUP BY 员工号,子工序,序号,zd_id,Operation_Code
	) q ON t.MaHang = q.MaHang COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AND t.OPTEN = q.TenCongDoan COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT and t.MaNS = q.MaNS
	WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY,t.Ngay,@NgayHT) = 0

	FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @MaHang
END

CLOSE cur1
DEALLOCATE cur1

create     PROC [dbo].[pr_LoadMaHang]
AS

Declare @DC nvarchar(30) = 'DT15'

select @DC = DiaChi from tblDiaChi

DECLARE @Mahang NVARCHAR(200)
DECLARE @TenKD NVARCHAR(200)
DECLARE @SoLuong INT 

DECLARE @sTma NVARCHAR(250)

DECLARE curr CURSOR FOR


SELECT MaHang,TenKieuDang,SoLuong 
FROM TNG.TNG_QLSX.dbo.tblBangUpChuyenTreo
WHERE DiaChi = @DC
AND DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), NgayKetThucSX) >=0

OPEN curr 
FETCH NEXT FROM curr INTO @Mahang,@TenKD,@SoLuong
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	
	IF  N' ' + @TenKD + N' ' LIKE N'%[ .,;:]bộ[ .,;:]%'
	BEGIN
		SET @sTma = @Mahang + '-A'
		EXEC pr_Insert_StyleOrderERP @sTma,@TenKD,@SoLuong
		SET @sTma = @Mahang + '-Q'
		EXEC pr_Insert_StyleOrderERP @sTma,@TenKD,@SoLuong
	END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
		EXEC pr_Insert_StyleOrderERP @Mahang ,@TenKD,@SoLuong
	END
    


	FETCH NEXT FROM curr INTO @Mahang,@TenKD,@SoLuong
END
CLOSE curr
DEALLOCATE curr

create   PROC [dbo].[pr_Insert_StyleOrderERP]
@Mahang NVARCHAR(200),
@KieuDang NVARCHAR(200),
@SoLuong INT
AS


IF NOT	 EXISTS(SELECT * FROM Style_Order WHERE Order_ID = @Mahang )
BEGIN

	INSERT INTO dbo.Style_Order
	(
		Order_ID,
		Order_Name,
		Customer_ID,
		Order_Date,
		Delivery_Date,
		Detail,
		bExt,
		uOrderHdrId,
		order_qty,
		colour,
		size,
		master_order,
		create_date,
		update_date
	)
	VALUES
	(   @Mahang,       -- Order_ID - nvarchar(50)
		@KieuDang,       -- Order_Name - nvarchar(50)
		0,         -- Customer_ID - int
		GETDATE(), -- Order_Date - datetime
		GETDATE(), -- Delivery_Date - datetime
		N'',       -- Detail - nvarchar(150)
		NULL,      -- bExt - bit
		NULL,      -- uOrderHdrId - uniqueidentifier
		@SoLuong,         -- order_qty - int
		N'',       -- colour - nvarchar(50)
		N'',       -- size - nvarchar(20)
		N'',       -- master_order - nvarchar(50)
		GETDATE(), -- create_date - datetime
		GETDATE()  -- update_date - datetime
		)
END

IF NOT  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.Style_Master WHERE Style_ID = @Mahang)
BEGIN

	INSERT INTO dbo.Style_Master
	(
		Style_ID,
		Description,
		Collection,
		Fabric,
		Trim,
		Logo_Name,
		Logo_Placement,
		Comments,
		Picture,
		create_date,
		update_date
	)
	VALUES
	(   @Mahang,       -- Style_ID - nvarchar(200)
		@KieuDang,       -- Description - nvarchar(50)
		N'',       -- Collection - nvarchar(20)
		N'',       -- Fabric - nvarchar(20)
		N'',       -- Trim - nvarchar(20)
		N'',       -- Logo_Name - nvarchar(20)
		N'',       -- Logo_Placement - nvarchar(20)
		N'',       -- Comments - nvarchar(255)
		N'',       -- Picture - nvarchar(100)
		GETDATE(), -- create_date - datetime
		GETDATE()  -- update_date - datetime
		)
END
